newsitem.title: UK: LME copper unchanged in late trading.
newsitem.headline: LME copper unchanged in late trading.

text.p: LME copper barely moved in late inter-office trading after a thin day trapped in a narrow band.
At 1800 GMT, three month copper was indicated at $1,942/45 per tonne, compared to an afternoon kerb close of $1,943.
The first level of resistance is pegged at $1,950, after which the more solid barrier of $1,970 comes into play.
The other metals were equally flat, with aluminium quoted at $1,483/87 compared to a kerb close of $1,486.50.
